Title: Verify registration with all valid data
Preconditions: Not logged in; email never used before
Test Data: Unique email (e.g. qa.user+001@example.com), valid name/DOB/address, strong password
Steps:
1. Open /auth/register
2. Fill all required fields with valid data
3. Click Register
Expected Result: Account is created and user is redirected to the login page; no error shown. [VERIFY exact redirect]

Title: Verify registration fails with an already registered email
Steps:
1. Open register page
2. Fill form using the existing email
3. Click Register
Expected Result: Registration rejected with a clear message that the email already exists; no duplicate account.

Title: Verify required-field validation when form is submitted empty
Steps:
1. Open register page
2. Click Register without entering data
Expected Result: Each required field shows a validation message; form is not submitted.

Title: Verify email format validation
Steps:
1. Fill form with each invalid email
2. Click Register
Expected Result: An email-format message is shown for each; account not created.

Title: Verify weak password is rejected
Test Data: Passwords: 123, abcdefgh, 12345678 (EP: short / letters only / digits only)
Steps:
1. Fill valid data with each weak password
2. Click Register
Expected Result: Password policy message shown; account not created. [VERIFY policy: min length, character types]

Title: Verify password length boundaries
Test Data: Password length: min-1, min, min+1 (find min from the app's message)
Steps:
1. Register with each length
2. Observe result
Expected Result: Below the minimum is rejected; minimum and above is accepted.

Title: Verify password field masks characters
Steps: 1. Type in the password field
Expected Result: Characters are masked.

Title: Verify registration handles special characters and very long text in text fields
Steps:
1. Enter the data in name fields
2. Submit
Expected Result: Input is rejected or safely stored/escaped; no script runs, no error page, no crash.

Title: Verify login with valid credentials
Steps:
1. Open /auth/login
2. Enter email and password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is logged in and lands on the account page; user name appears in the header.

Title: Verify login fails with wrong password
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter valid email and wrong password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message shown (e.g. invalid email or password); user stays on login page.

Title: Verify login fails with unregistered email
Steps:
1. Enter data
2. Click Login
Expected Result: Error shown; message does not reveal whether the email exists. [VERIFY actual message]

Title: Verify validation when both fields are blank
Steps: 1. Click Login with empty form
Expected Result: Required-field messages appear for both fields.

Title: Verify invalid email format on login
Steps:
1. Enter data
2. Click Login
Expected Result: Email-format validation message is shown.

Title: Verify logout ends the session
Steps:
1. Log in
2. Click user menu > Sign out
3. Press browser Back button
Expected Result: User is logged out; account page is not shown without logging in again.

Title: Verify account page is inaccessible without login
Steps: 1. Open /account directly in a new session
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page; no account data shown.

Title: Verify login handles SQL-like input safely
Steps:
1. Enter data
2. Click Login
Expected Result: Rejected normally; no login, no server error page.

Title: Verify adding a product to the cart
Steps: 1. Click Add to cart
Expected Result: Confirmation shown; cart icon count becomes 1; item appears in cart.

Title: Verify adding the same product twice
Steps: 1. Add the same product again
Expected Result: Quantity increases to 2 (single line item); no duplicate line. [VERIFY]

Title: Verify adding different products
Steps:
1. Add product A
2. Add product B
Expected Result: Both are listed; cart count is 2 (or total quantity).

Title: Verify updating quantity in the cart
Steps:
1. Open cart
2. Change quantity to 3
Expected Result: Line total and cart total update correctly.

Title: Verify removing an item from the cart
Steps:
1. Open cart
2. Click remove on the item
Expected Result: Item is removed; totals update; empty cart message when last item removed.

Title: Verify cart total calculation
Steps:
1. Add items with known prices
2. Calculate expected total by hand
3. Compare with cart total
Expected Result: Total equals the sum of price x quantity of every line.

Title: Verify cart quantity set to zero or negative
Steps: 1. Edit quantity to each value
Expected Result: Rejected, or item removed for 0; never a negative total.

Title: Verify cart persists after page refresh
Steps:
1. Refresh the page
2. Open the cart
Expected Result: Items are still present.

Title: Verify cart behaviour when a guest logs in
Steps:
1. Add item as guest
2. Log in
3. Open cart
Expected Result: Defined behaviour: cart kept or merged, no lost or duplicated items. [VERIFY]

Title: Verify complete checkout end to end
Test Data: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01 (confirm on login page); valid address; payment: Cash on Delivery
Steps:
1. Open cart > Proceed to checkout
2. Confirm sign-in step
3. Fill billing address
4. Choose payment
5. Confirm
Expected Result: Order is placed; confirmation message or invoice number shown; cart is emptied. [VERIFY]

Title: Verify checkout requires login
Steps:
1. Open cart as guest
2. Click Proceed to checkout
Expected Result: User is asked to log in or register before continuing.

Title: Verify billing address required fields
Steps:
1. Leave fields empty
2. Click Proceed
Expected Result: Validation messages shown; user cannot continue.

Title: Verify each payment method can be selected
Steps: 1. Select each method in turn
Expected Result: Method-specific fields appear and the order can be placed. [VERIFY list]

Title: Verify credit card validation
Test Data: Invalid number, expired date, blank CVV
Steps:
1. Enter invalid card data
2. Confirm
Expected Result: Validation messages shown; order not placed.

Title: Verify order total at checkout matches the cart
Steps:
1. Note cart total
2. Go through checkout
Expected Result: Total shown at checkout and on confirmation equals the cart total.

Title: Verify double click on the confirm button
Steps: 1. Double-click Confirm
Expected Result: Only one order is created.

Title: Verify refreshing during checkout does not lose or duplicate the order
Steps: 1. Refresh on a middle step
Expected Result: User keeps progress or restarts cleanly; no duplicate order.
